title: Octopic YAML Data File
description: A YAML data file consumed by 'auto: data' (via 'data.yaml: path'). Defines typed column schemas ('datatypes:') and row data ('data:'). Supports two formats: 'csv-homogenous' (default) where rows are comma-separated strings, and 'map-heterogeneous' where rows are key-value mappings.

format.description: Data layout format. 'csv-homogenous': rows are CSV strings (or lists) split into fields defined by 'datatypes:'. 'map-heterogeneous': rows are key-value mappings deserialized by type-specific handlers. Default: 'csv-homogenous'.

datatypes.description: Column schema. Each entry defines how one block of columns is deserialized. Order matters: entries are applied left-to-right across the CSV columns. Only used in 'csv-homogenous' format.

variables.description: Common variables available during template expansion within this data file. Substituted via ${name}.

delimiters.description: Delimiter overrides for this data file.

alternatives_delimiter.description: Delimiter used to separate alternative values within a single cell, producing the cartesian product of rows. Default: ':'.

array_delimiter.description: Delimiter used by Data subclasses (Fields, MetaData, SnippetData) to separate array-valued entries within a single CSV cell. The subclass replaces this delimiter with ',' before further processing. Default: ';'.

data.description: Row data. In 'csv-homogenous' format, each item is a CSV string, a YAML list (auto-joined with commas), a OctoYAML include directive, or an auto-generator node. In 'map-heterogeneous' format, each item is a key-value mapping dict.

DatatypeEntry.description: One datatype entry in 'datatypes:'. Can be a single column-group definition or a list of such definitions (twin/multi-column form: all groups must consume the same number of columns).

oneOf.description: Twin/multi-column form. Each spec in the list is applied to the same column range simultaneously (column widths must match). Only supported with named Data subclasses, not list-form field definitions.

DatatypeSpec.description: Column-group definition. 'datatype' is the field list or named Data subclass. Optional 'prefix' scopes the exported variable names.

datatype.description: Column definition. A list of strings names the fields consumed left-to-right: ['field1', 'field2']. A string names a registered Data subclass (e.g. 'Fields', 'MetaData', 'SnippetData') that deserializes the columns itself.

oneOf.description: List of field names. Each name maps to one CSV column in order.
Name of a registered Data subclass that handles deserialization. Built-in: 'Fields', 'MetaData', 'SnippetData'. Custom subclasses can be added via plugins.

prefix.description: Prefix applied to variable names produced by this datatype. Resulting names: ${prefix.field}. Used to avoid collisions in twin/multi-column forms.

DataItem.description: One item in the 'data:' list. Can be a CSV row string, a YAML list row, a OctoYAML include directive, or an auto-generator node.

oneOf.description: CSV row string. Fields are split by comma. Backslash at end of line continues on the next physical line (leading whitespace on continuation lines is stripped). Alternative values within a cell are separated by 'alternatives_delimiter' (default ':') to produce the cartesian product.
Row given as a YAML list. Items are converted to strings and joined with commas before parsing.

DataImportDirective.description: Import directive inside 'data:'. A sole '<import>:' splices rows from an external file in place. Pointing at an empty file is silently ignored.

<import>.description: Path to a YAML file whose top-level list of rows is spliced in place of this directive.

variables.description: Variables substituted into the imported file before splicing.

enabled.description: If false, this include is skipped entirely.

DataAutoNode.description: An auto-generator node inside 'data:'. Generates row strings programmatically. The 'template:' items must be strings (CSV row templates), not action nodes. Supports the same auto types as task actions: 'args', 'range', 'data'.

oneOf.description: Multi-source form: multiple sources zipped by row index.

template.description: One or more CSV row template strings expanded per iteration. ${var} substitution is applied to each string.

index.description: Starting value for the loop index. Default: 1.

eval.description: Python expressions producing derived variables for 'auto: args'.

delimiter.description: Delimiter for splitting arg value strings. Default: ','.

range.description: Range spec for 'auto: range'. Single integer N → range(N); list [stop] or [start, stop] or [start, stop, step].

data.csv.description: Path to a CSV data file for 'auto: data'.

data.yaml.description: Path to a YAML data file for 'auto: data'.

filter.description: Row filter expression for 'auto: data'. {} is the row dict; {.index} is 0-based row index; [:key:] is dict-key shorthand.

filter.var.description: Variable name whose value is used as the filter expression.

range.ie.description: Like 'range' but excludes empty rows before index selection.

DataAutoSourceSpec.description: One source entry in a multi-source 'auto: [...]' node within 'data:'. Same semantics as task-level AutoSourceSpec.
